blocks.prompt: 3. An expression for the \(n\)th triangular number is \(\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\). Write down the 15th triangular number.
blocks.explanation:
Triangular numbers (tikon numbers) woh hain jitne dots se ek tikon (triangle) banti hai: 1 dot, phir 3 dots (1 + 2 ki do qataarein), phir 6 dots (1 + 2 + 3), waghera.
Sawal ne \(n\)th term ka formula khud de diya hai, humein sirf 15th term chahiye, yani \(n = 15\).
Plan: pehle chhote \(n\) par formula check karenge taake samajh aaye, phir \(n = 15\) rakhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n\)th triangular number \(= \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\)
Humein find karna hai: 15th triangular number.
Tareeqa: Formula mein \(n = 15\) rakhenge. Formula \(1 + 2 + \cdots + n\) ka jama hai, is liye har qadam par dots ki ek nayi qataar judti hai.

Chhote \(n\) par formula check karein
\[n = 1:\ \dfrac{1 \cdot 2}{2} = 1\]
\[n = 2:\ \dfrac{2 \cdot 3}{2} = 3\]
\[n = 3:\ \dfrac{3 \cdot 4}{2} = 6\]
Kyun: Pehle teen triangular numbers 1, 3, 6 hain (1 dot; 1 + 2 = 3 dots; 1 + 2 + 3 = 6 dots). Formula yahi de raha hai, is liye hum ne isay sahi samjha hai. Yeh aadat achhi hai: anjaane formula ko pehle chhoti values par aazma lein.

\(n = 15\) rakhein
\[\dfrac{15(15 + 1)}{2} = \dfrac{15 \times 16}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{240}{2} = 120\]
Kyun: Pehle bracket: \(15 + 1 = 16\). Phir \(15 \times 16 = 240\), aur 2 se divide kiya to 120. Aasaan tareeqa: pehle 16 ko 2 se divide kar lein, \(15 \times 8 = 120\).
Dhyan dein: \(n(n + 1)\) mein \(n\) ko \((n + 1)\) se multiply karna hai; \(15 \times 15 + 1\) likhna ghalat hai.

Tasdeeq
\[1 + 2 + \cdots + 15 = 120 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 15th triangular number pehle 15 natural numbers ka jama hai. Jore banayein: \(1 + 15, 2 + 14, \ldots, 7 + 9\) saat jore, har ek 16 ka, yani 112, aur beech mein 8 bacha: \(112 + 8 = 120\). Wohi jawab.
